svg.text: A — POWER ENTRY, VGND & OPA_BIAS REFERENCES
Live but UNLOADED. NOT connected to GND.
0.877 V calc / 0.874 V meas — Rth 8.25 kΩ
B — U1 · OPA1642 HIGH-IMPEDANCE BUFFER (SOURCE PATH)
J4 superseded the J1 3.5 mm breakout as the
VALUE PROVENANCE: C1 read from its marking (BC103 = 10nF). C2 / C6 / C8 and the 0.1µF ceramics
stated at the bench (reported, not read back). R1–R4 derived from the measured 0.874 V bias node;
R5 derived from the measured 1 kHz response (0.9848 vs 0.9867 predicted). See netlist.md §2 and §4a.
col 48 A–E fans out two ways: the permanent
⚠ J2 (3.5 mm open stub, 48a) was DISCONNECTED
Unused channel B terminated as a
specified 100 kΩ in series to pin 5.
As built it is a direct tie. Benign —
U4 pin 5 shares this node (col 38 F–J), through the single
jumper 38j → 41c. If it lifts, both channel Bs lose bias.
C — TEENSY ↔ AUDIO SHIELD INTERFACE (NATIVE STACK)
header — shield's use of it NYV
header — bonds shield and board grounds
fed from RELAY_RETURN COM (16a), block F — TS or XLR return
⚠ joint resoldered and new jumper fitted 2026-10-18 (RPT)
Net names are CODEC-REFERENCED: I2S_DIN = codec data IN (Teensy 7, SAI1_TX_DATA0);
I2S_DOUT = codec data OUT (Teensy 8, SAI1_RX_DATA0). See netlist.md §4.
Clocks derive from SAMPLE_RATE 44100. Scope-confirmed on the REPLACED boards:
LRCLK 44.108 kHz · BCLK ~2.82 MHz · MCLK ~11.29 MHz (journal 2026-09-06 (1))
SGTL5000 identified functionally over I²C, not from its package marking.
The shield's use of the 5V pad is UNVERIFIED. Pin 15 stubs to the unpopulated VOL pad.
THE HEADER STACK IS THE INTERCONNECT, SINCE 2026-09-13:
• Shield → Teensy → carrier, soldered. New boards. No flying leads.
• Idle: SOURCE −65.39, RETURN −65.26 dBFS, LINE-IN-L open
• U2 is I²S MASTER — it generates MCLK / BCLK / LRCLK
"The stack fixed it" is NOT established. What is
established: this assembly does not reproduce the fault.
D — RESERVED, AND HARDWARE DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT
Everything else is BUILT — see blocks E to H. What is left here is not "pending": the four jack-detect inputs are
decided against (ADR-003, ADR-004) and nothing lands on those pins. The firmware still defines them in config.h.
H — RASPBERRY PI 5 LINK · PHASE 10 · RECEIVE-ONLY
The Pi physically cannot send to the Teensy. No 3.3 V or 5 V rail is shared; each board keeps its
own supply. Reference capture: 36 481 B/s, zero CRC failures (journal 2026-10-13 (9)).
E — RELAY_SEND · K1 · PHASE 6 · breadboard cols 49–59
pin 14 → col 53; R6 col 53 → 51, 0.993 kΩ meas
pin 14 LOW = buffer output → Rig Send (default, and the boot state)
pin 14 HIGH = codec LINE OUT L → Rig Send (monitor / injection path)
Contact map is proven BY STATE, not from the datasheet. 56a↔58a read OPEN in BOTH states,
which is what rules out a welded or make-before-break contact.
Pole 2 (56f / 57f / 58f) is NOT wired and has never been tested — NYV.
⚠ The coil is POLARIZED and was built backwards first: runbook step 7 inverts pins 1 and 10.
Built that way the coil energises normally and the contacts never transfer.
J5 tip lead reseated at 57b on 2026-10-11, the same
strip as COM 57a, after it was found out of the board.
Since the stack, Audio Shield GND and the breadboard
rail are one net. Sleeve → rail 0.2 Ω (MEAS).
F — RELAY_RETURN · K2 · PHASE 7 · breadboard cols 8–18
14f: 4.98 V at rest · coil 4.78 V energised
→ U3 LINE IN R · I²S ch 1
pin 15 LOW = TS return → LINE IN R (default, and the boot state)
pin 15 HIGH = XLR return → LINE IN R
J6 sleeve → GND, 0.9 Ω. J7 pins 1 AND 3 land on the BREADBOARD TOP_GND rail (pin 1
repaired 2026-10-11). The 33.1 dB between that rail and Audio Shield GND predates the
stack, which bonds them. Risk R5 is historical and has not been re-measured.
J7's detect microswitch (D2F-01L) is NOT BUILT — ADR-004. Pole 2 (15f / 16f / 17f)
not wired, and K2's own package marking has never been read back — both NYV.
⚠ This driver once stalled in the active region
during reseating. The bad connection was NEVER
identified. If it returns, measure the R8 drop
G — AMP OUT · U4 · ANALOG BRANCH OF RETURN_NODE · cols 21–29
C9: col 24 F–J → col 23 F–J → GND
Unused channel B terminated as a
unity follower. Pin 5 lands on col 38 F–J,
U1's pin 5 node. Pin 7 reads 0.872 V.
U4 pins 1 / 2 / 3: 0.876 V. J8 tip → sleeve: 0.000 V DC.
A guitar through a real rig gives a strum-correlated waveform at
J8 (2026-10-12), audible in an amp. NOT calibrated, and no J8
amplitude is quotable (TODO-75). Opens: TODO-69 steps 0b, 3, 5.
J8 follows K2. The branch is analog, so the amp signal does
not depend on the codec, the firmware or digital latency.
⚠ HAZARD H-2: col 28 A–E is RETURN_NODE and col 27 A–E is U4 pin 4, GND. They are adjacent.
A one-column slip shorts the selected return to ground.
⚠ C10 was first built on pin 1, the OUTPUT. It passed every DC check, because a coupling cap
blocks DC in either position. Moved 2026-10-12. Predicted leak via OPA_BIAS: TODO-70, unmeasured.
TIERS ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE. A part's POSITION and its VALUE are separate claims and are tagged separately.
Strip/column assignments are PHYS. Hole-level row letters are RPT (builder-reported), including every coordinate in blocks E to H.
NYV BY DECISION — open on purpose, not by oversight:
• TOP_RED continuity col 5 ↔ col 55 (GAP-5). A Phase 7 rail check would close it, but top-vs-bottom was never confirmed.
• Carrier 5V terminal provenance (X-5) · C3/C4/C5/C7 values (A1) · whether Rev D uses the 5V pad (D2).
• K2's and J7's package markings — never read back. Pole 2 of both relays — wired to nothing, never tested.
BLOCKS E TO H ARE TRANSCRIBED FROM THE BENCH RECORD, NOT FROM A FRESH INSPECTION.
Blocks A and B were captured against the board and photographs on 2026-09-07. E and F were assembled on 2026-09-22 and C, G
and H on 2026-10-31 from ai/journal.md, ai/todo.md and ai/evidence/. Nothing was promoted; see netlist.md §14 and §21.
THIS DRAWING REFLECTS THE PHYSICAL BOARD, NOT docs/breadboard_bringup_v3.md.
The runbook carries documented defects in Phase 6 coil polarity, the transistor pin order and the Phase 7 column siting,
and has no phase for Amp Out. Where they conflict, the board governs. Construction complete ≠ signed off ≠ validated —
Phase 9 has not been run, and the instrument is not calibrated.
